PARKS, RECREATION & COMMUNITY SERVICES COMMISSION

Welcome to the meeting of the Parks, Recreation & Community Services Commission. Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6) and rebroadcast
throughout the week. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs and videotapes of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk’s Office by calling
(818) 548-2090. Meetings are also archived on the City website for viewing anytime at www.ci.glendale.ca.us/video_archives.asp.
PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES AND PAGERS WHILE INSIDE THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request.
Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for requests regarding sign language
translation and Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and
are public records, will be available for review in the Community Services & Parks Administration Office, 613 E. Broadway, Room 120, Glendale, CA 91206. If you have
any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact (818) 548-2782 during regular business hours.

minutes_text:
PARKS, RECREATION & COMMUNITY SERVICES COMMISSION

  MEETING MINUTES
  Monday, July 15, 2019, 2:30 p.m.
  Council Chambers, 613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor, Glendale, CA 91206
1.  ROLL CALL

  The meeting was called to order at 2:35 p.m.

  Present: Commissioners Babaian, Kalfayan, Michals, and Wolfson
  Absent: None

  A.  Report of Recording Clerk, re: Posting of the Agenda. Ms. Moreno Hernandez reported that the
  agenda for the July 15, 2019, regular meeting was posted on the bulletin board outside City Hall on
  or before Friday, July 12, 2019.

At this time, Ms. Moreno Hernandez announced that Elen Asatryan, who had been serving as President of
the Commission since November 2018, had recently resigned from the Commission, and therefore staff
recommended that a President Pro-Tem be selected until the Commission is full again. Commissioner
Wolfson was selected as President Pro-Tem by unanimous consensus. Because Commissioner Wolfson
had been serving as Secretary of the Commission, a new Secretary Pro-Tem had to be selected.
Commissioner Babaian was selected as Commission Secretary Pro-Tem by unanimous consensus.
2.  UPCOMING COUNCIL AGENDA ITEMS
  Director of Community Services & Parks Onnig Bulanikian read a list of upcoming City Council agenda
  items related to the Community Services & Parks Department (CSP).
3.  COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
  President Pro-Tem Wolfson and Commissioner Michals expressed their appreciation for former
  Commissioner and Commission President Asatryan’s service and wished her well.

  Commissioner Michals asked if the parking lot across the street from Verdugo Park was available for
  parking for the Summer Concerts in the Park Series, to which staff replied affirmatively. Commissioner
  Michals said that he would like to see signage there to make it clear to concert-goers.

  Deputy Director of Community Services & Parks Koko Panossian commented that he spoke to staff
  from the Public Works Forestry Section regarding the gender of trees in the City of Glendale, and
  confirmed that staff would give a report at a future Commission meeting.
4.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  None.
5.  CONSENT ITEMS (Including Minutes)
  A. Approval of the Minutes of the Commission regular meeting held on June 17, 2019.

  Moved:  Commissioner Kalfayan
  Seconded: Commissioner Michals

  1
   That the minutes of the Commission regular meeting held on June 17, 2019, be approved as
  written.

  A roll call was conducted and Commissioners voted as follows:

  Ayes:  Commissioners Babaian, Kalfayan, Michals, and President Pro-Tem Wolfson
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  None

6.  REPORTS – INFORMATION ONLY
  A. Section Activity Reports
  1.  Recreation & Community Services
  Mr. Garabetian gave a report and PowerPoint presentation covering the following topics:
  Programs at Community Centers, Youth & Family Services, STAR, Trails & Open Space,
  Upcoming Events, and July is Parks Make Life Better Month.

  Commissioner Kalfayan asked if the Summer Concerts in the Park were offered every week
  during the series.

  2.  Park Services
  Mr. Panossian provided a brief overview of work orders completed by Park Services staff in
  the month of June, highlighting projects at Central Library, Adams Square Mini Park, Harvard
  Mini Park, Emerald Isle Park, Glendale Heritage Garden, Maple Park, and Montrose Park.

7.  ADJOURNMENT
  The meeting was adjourned at 3:03 p.m.
